inn_landlord.text: The old hotel's been here since 1875. Jan de Groot, the Dutchman who ran the ferry to Orkney, had eight sons, and legend says they argued about who sat at the head of the table.
So Jan built an eight-sided house with an eight-sided table, and every son had the head of it. There's a little octagonal tower on the hotel to remember him. Clever man. Tired man.

e2e_walker.text: Sixty-two days from Land's End. Two pairs of boots. Fourteen blisters, all named. I'm going to sit in this chair until the chair becomes part of me.
Best bit? The Pennines. Worst bit? Also the Pennines. Wettest bit? Scotland, all of it, lovingly.
